Story branch story/b575-ac1c-f720-4839/45da-5043-aa3e-4f3c-scoped (18 commits) contains the v1.1.0 cycle-ledger implementation: stability.py (Jaccard similarity + finding_hash + should_halt), cycle_dispatcher.py (next_action halt logic), cycle_ledger.py Python reader/writer, write-cycle-ledger.sh, and corresponding tests. The branch was parked in worktree-20260516-155317 (now deleted) and preserved on origin as story/b575-ac1c-f720-4839/45da-5043-aa3e-4f3c-scoped.

Before this work can be salvaged, the branch needs a rebase onto main and conflict resolution across 6 files: cycle_ledger.py (story has v1.1.0 at 377 lines; main has v1.2.0 at 475 lines — main is a strict superset adding pr_number/sentinel migration), cycle-ledger.md (schema version 1.1.0 vs 1.2.0 header conflict), write-cycle-ledger.sh (268-line divergence), test_cycle_ledger.py (both branches created the file independently), conftest.py (both sides added fixtures), and .test-index (additive). stability.py and cycle_dispatcher.py are byte-for-byte identical in both branches — main already absorbed those implementations — so the functional core is safe. The conflict is entirely about the cycle-ledger schema upgrade to v1.2.0 that landed in main while this branch was parked.
